## Contributing to this site

This website is maintained in the open. Corrections, additions to the [open problems](research/open-problems.qmd) list, publication entries, and news items are all welcome as pull requests.

[Open an issue](https://github.com/yunkang2021/pollinatormodeling.github.io/issues){.btn-x .solid}
[View the repository](https://github.com/yunkang2021/pollinatormodeling.github.io){.btn-x}

## Contributing data

If you hold colony monitoring data and would consider contributing it to the shared inventory, see [Data & software](data.qmd). Contributing to the inventory does not require making data public — the first step is documenting what exists.

## Acknowledgements

This collaboration originated at a workshop hosted by the [American Institute of Mathematics](https://aimath.org/), March 30 – April 5, 2026. Prior work by participants has been supported by NSF-DMS awards 1313312, 1716802, 2052820 and 2602341, and by the USDA Agricultural Research Service.
